name: Windows-Use
description: Agent that operates Windows through the UI Automation API, letting any LLM click, type and run PowerShell without a vision model.
whatItDoes: Completes desktop tasks on Windows from a plain-language instruction: managing windows, using applications, running shell commands and reading web pages. It is for users and developers who want computer use on Windows with ordinary text models.
howItWorks: Instead of screenshots, the agent reads the accessibility tree exposed by Windows and gives that structure to the model, which chooses a tool call such as click, type, scroll or shell. An interactive terminal command starts it, with flags for provider, model and step limit, and it is also importable as a Python library.
models: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama and others
